proposal.summary: CMSUno before 1.6.1 (uno.php) is vulnerable to CSRF that allows an attacker to change the admin password via a crafted POST form.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the presence/absence of anti-CSRF tokens in uno.php and reproduce the PoC; if confirmed, require and verify a CSRF token and publish a patched release (>=1.6.1) and advisory.
